claims.label: asset_management
claims.claim: Within the documented Huma Institutional product, lenders supply pooled capital and pool owners manage that pool, select the EA and set parameters. That directly describes management of user capital under the proposed rule.

claims.label: allocation
claims.claim: Within that Institutional pool, a designated EA selects eligible borrowers and credit terms; approval permits those borrowers to draw pool capital. This identifies the controlling actor, capital source and borrower destinations.

claims.label: asset_management
claims.claim: The corpus names Solana Huma V2, while these operational sources identify Huma Institutional. The retained Huma 2.0 FAQ is only a pointer to the dApp. No retained source establishes the version relationship required to transfer the scoped management finding to this exact unit.

claims.label: allocation
claims.claim: The same unresolved product/version relationship prevents accepting the Institutional allocation behavior as the exact Solana V2 unit behavior. The source-scoped positive predicate remains recorded independently.

claims.label: attester
claims.claim: An EA evaluates receivable quality for drawdown and can declare defaults; this describes underwriting and administrative decisions.

claims.label: attester
claims.claim: No retained source specifies an attestation assertion or schema and its acceptance as evidence for a financial transition, separately from the EA authorizing credit. Both the attestation predicate and unit applicability remain unestablished.

qualifications: Three bodies were retained, but the Huma 2.0 FAQ body contains only a dApp pointer, not the detailed FAQ text seen in search rendering. It counts toward the body cap and receives no credit for that stale text.
The two substantive operational pages are visibly under Huma Institutional. The corpus combines a V2 name, Solana and institutional-style EA/tranche claims; none alone resolves product identity.

The source-scoped asset_management and allocation predicates are supported for the documented Institutional behavior; unit-level proposed dispositions remain not_evidenced until the relationship is independently established.

No extra Huma Prime, permissionless PST mode, credit legal recourse or oracle roles are imported. The EA is not automatically an attester because it evaluates receivables or sends an authorized transaction.
No signed claim format, credit acceptance implementation, deployed program, actual borrower allocation or legal agreement was inspected.
next_step: First bind the corpus unit to the appropriate Huma protocol version and deployment family. Then independently review the two scoped positive predicates. For attester, require a named assertion and consuming transition beyond ordinary credit authorization.
